out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at the bar area did not have any water service as the bar is no longer used according to the person in charge. The bar is used to serve glasses of wine and beer.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. The person in charge turned on the water supply to the bar handsink during the inspection to correct. The water temperature was 118º.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: a large container of flour and a smaller container of bread crumbs were not covered while in storage on the dry goods shelving. Also observed a large bowl of cut lettuce that was uncovered in the Pepsi refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. The person in charge covered the foods during the inspection.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: numerous 1-quart containers of sauces made on-site (sweet and sour, spicy mayo, honey wasabi, and yellow curry to name a few) were not date marked. Some were, but most weren’t.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The person in charge labeled the unlabeled containers during the inspection to correct. Please ensure all ready to eat TCS foods made on-site site and held for more than 24 hours are date marked in the future.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. A large 2-gallon sprayer container containing degreaser for cleaning the kitchen was not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The person in charge labeled the container during the inspection.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: one sheet pan of raw frozen chicken (~20#) was being thawed at room temperature on a speed rack (sheet pan cart on wheels) in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Please discontinue thawing chicken and other foods at room temperature. Thaw according to one of the methods listed above. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. There were several food items stored on the floor in the kitchen including 5-gallon buckets of soy sauce, large containers or ginger, and others.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing food on the floor. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. There were at least two occurrences of wet wiping cloths stored on the counter and not in a sanitizing solution, as required.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Please discontinue storing wet wiping cloths on the counter. Store them in a sanitizing solution between uses. The person in charge moved the cloths to a sanitizing solution during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: spoons and scoops for cooked rice were stored in 74º standing water in two locations.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Discontinue storing in use utensils in standing water. The PIC (person in charge) removed the spoons from the standing water during the inspection.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the outside of the white freezer next to the deep fat fryer was visibly soiled with food, grease and other foods debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. The person in charge had staff clean the area during the inspection.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. An unapproved splitter was installed on the mop sink. The person in charge has the correct device from the last inspection, but did not install it.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The person in charge installed the correct device during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The PIC could not produce a vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS provided the PIC with the model FCHD policy, which will be adopted. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Due to the unit not working correctly, there were no paper towels at the hand sink in the rear of the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no hand washing sign at the wait station hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Provide a “employees must wash hands“ sign at this handsink as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Package Integrity
violations.observation: The following food item(s) from damaged packaging were found offered for sale or service: there were two severely dented cans of soy sauce on the dry storage shelving in the back of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food packages such as canned goods shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants. Return all dented and damaged canned goods to your food supplier for a credit. To manage corrected this by segregating the cans and returning or discarding them.CDI. PASSION FIN BISTRO & SUSHI BAR (Inspection Date: 03/12/2026) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: The PIC could not produce parasite destruction letters for two of the three fish providers. The parasite destruction letter on hand for the remaining provider was over 10 years old.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. Obtain up to date parasite destruction letters from all fish providers within three days. Parasite destruction letter should be updated yearly.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken and pooled shelled eggs were stored over cooked noodles in the prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC corrected this by moving the noodles above the eggs and raw chicken during the inspection. CDI. PASSION FIN BISTRO & SUSHI BAR (Inspection Date: 03/12/2026) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: several rice utensils fell on the floor during the inspection. An employee took them to the back and returned with them very quickly intending to use them again. Upon discussion with the employee it was discovered that the utensils were not run through the ware washing machine or in a sanitizing basin at the three compartment sink (no sanitizing basin was set at the time) so they were not properly sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The EHS educated the PIC on the proper way to wash, rinse and sanitize dishes in either the dishwasher or at the three compartment sink. The utensils were run through the dishwasher during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked tofu was 57° in the two door prep unit and cooked one hour ago. Green and white dumplings were 49° and 53° in the three door prep unit. Prepared salad dressing was 54°, mango sauce was 44°, and yellow curry was 44° in the walk-in refrigerator. Tofu on the ice bath in the kitchen was 51°. Sushi rice at the sushi prep line was 68°F for three hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The tofu in the prep unit was moved to the walk-in to cool. The green and white dumplings were moved to the walk-in to cool. The salad dressing, mango sauce, and yellow curry in the walk-in were moved to the other side of the walk-in. It was determined they were being stored in the warmest part of the walk-in. (Half an hour after moving, the temperature of these products had been reduced by 1°.) The tofu on the ice bath was discarded. CDI. The EHS advised the PIC to discard the sushi rice after one hour. The PIC requested to put the sushi rice on time as a public health control going forward. A TPHC procedure for sushi rice was created during the inspection and will be entered into the establishment record.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: a few prepared sauces stored in 1-quart plastic containers in the walk-in were date-marked, but several others were not.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. All foods prepared on site and held for more than 24 hours must be date marked. Please correct as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed two spray bottles containing chemicals and one large spray pump dispenser containing hood, degreaser, all unlabeled in the food prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled all the unlabeled toxic during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: tofu cooked this morning was put in the prep unit hot it was 57°.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. The EHS educated the PIC on proper cooling techniques and provided the PIC with a cooling handout.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw chicken was being thawed and standing water at the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. The EHS educated the PIC on how to properly thaw foods under running water, in the microwave, as part of the cooking process, or in the refrigerator.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device was found out of calibration in the range of use. The PICs food thermometer was not properly calibrated and read 34° in an ice water bath.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. The PIC had another thermometer which was properly calibrated. CDI.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. Observed mouse droppings on the floor in the unused dining room and the cabinets there.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. There were numerous items stored on the floor in this room, making it difficult to inspect for pests.

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Move all foods off the floor and discontinue storing food on the floor as soon as possible or within the next 90 days.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: there were several instances where bowls or plastic containers were being used to dispense ingredients or foods from storage containers and not handled utensils, as required.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed utensils and equipment being stored on the floor in the unused dining room.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Discontinue storing equipment and utensils on the floor as soon as possible within 90 days.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location

violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean all refrigerator door handles as soon as possible or within 10 days.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. A splitter was installed on the mop sink faucet with hoses attached. The backflow prevention device on the faucet is not designed for this set-up.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Remove the hoses and the splitter if not needed, or replace with splitter with a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. The manager ordered the device during the inspection and disconnected the hoses to temporarily remedy the issue. Please let your EHS know when the new splitter is installed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the hood system over the cooking area was visibly soiled with grease (dripping in several areas) and dust and is in need of cleaning. Several ceiling panels were very dusty and in need of cleaning or replacement.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the grease and dust from the hood and the ceiling panels as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the drop ceiling is not maintained in good repair. Several panels are missing and not installed properly and not sealed to prevent pest entry. Several light fixtures in the kitchen were not working, reducing required illumination.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: IN USE SUSHI KNIVES STORED ON SOILED TRAYS BETWEEN COUNTER TOP AND UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATION UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE KNIVES AND TRAYS TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: BEVERAGE AIR 1 DOOR PREP TOP (SUSHI) AT 48F AND DISPLAY (SUSHI-RIGHT) AT 43F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO OTHER REFRIGERATION UNITS. DO NOT USE UNITS TO STORE TCS FOODS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: CONNECTED TO MOP SINK FAUCET WITH HOSE AND SPRAY NOZZLE ATTACHED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE HOSE UNTIL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE HAS BEEN INSTALLED ON MOP SINK FAUCET.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Food containers were not proper covered during storage inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CORRECTED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:TERIYAKI SAIUCE AT STEAM TABLE=90F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. REHEATED TO 169F

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: A VARFIET OF SAUCES AN D OTHER FOOD ITREMS NOTED WITHOUT DATE MAKINGS, IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. SEVERAL BOXES OF FOOD WERE OBSERVED STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR, WALK-IN FREEZER, AND IN THE DRY STORAGE AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PROVIDE DUNNAGE RACKS OR ADDITIONAL SHELVING TO STORE ALL FOOD SUPPLIES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. WET WIPING TOWELS WERE OBSERVED ON CUTTING BOARDS AND ON TABLES AND NOT IN SANITIZING SOLUTIONS, IN THE KITCHEN AND AT THE SUSHI BAR..
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PASSION FIN BISTRO & SUSHI BAR (Inspection Date: 02/07/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped PLASTIC knives, forks, or spoons were not stored with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Dispensing Equip, Design to Protect Aspetic Package
violations.observation: The CUPS USED TO MEASURE BULK SUGAR, FLOUR, AND LOTHER BULK FOODS DO NOT HAVE HANDLES AND MAY CAUSE THESE FOODS TO BE CONTAMINATED.
violations.corrective_action: The equipment used to contain the liquid food must meet the design and construction requirements to (1) maintain the commercial sterility of aseptically packaged food in a homogenous liquid form for a specified duration from the time of opening the packaging within the equipment and (2) conform to the specifications for this equipment as specified in NSF/ANSI 18-2006 Manual Food and beverage Dispensing Equipment. REPLACE THESE CUPS WITH MEASURING SCOOPS THAT HAVE LONG HANDLES.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the GREASE FILTERS UNDFER THE HOOD SYSTEM ARE IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
